display_long_description:
Step into the driver's seat and experience the excitement of Horizon Chase: Car Racing Game, a fast-paced VR racing adventure that delivers thrilling arcade action and immersive driving. Explore beautifully designed highways, city streets, coastal roads, and scenic landscapes as you compete in exciting races and push your skills to the limit.

Choose from a variety of powerful sports cars, each offering a unique driving experience. Master sharp corners, maintain top speed, avoid traffic, and finish every race ahead of your rivals. Whether you're chasing the fastest lap or completing challenging racing events, every moment is packed with speed, precision, and excitement.

Designed for VR, the game features intuitive controls, smooth performance, and an immersive first-person driving experience that makes every race feel intense and rewarding. Improve your racing techniques, unlock new cars, and take on increasingly difficult challenges as you progress through the game.

Features:
• High-speed arcade racing in VR.
• Multiple highways, city roads, and scenic environments.
• A selection of powerful sports cars to drive.
• Responsive controls with smooth and immersive gameplay.
• Challenging races, time-based events, and skill-based objectives.
• Unlock new vehicles and progress through exciting gameplay.
• Suitable for both casual players and racing enthusiasts.

Start your engine, accelerate to top speed, and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate racing champion.
